title: Shadow Swap
summary: Experimental public-asset AMM pools, liquidity provision and NFT marketplace templates for Ootle testnet, formerly Tari/Ootle Liquidity Protocol. November5 review of revision 1d65d87 found the v0.48 reset cohort6a25dbc and no live public deployment. The README preserves v0.46 settlements and four template publications as historical pre-reset evidence; no Shadow Swap templates are published on the reset network. Mainnet is disabled. Public pools exclude confidential and stealth assets; the separate revealed-asset design exposes amounts and timing. MIT-licensed source and illustrative UI fixtures remain available. The November5 recording walks through current deployment documentation, not a running exchange.
creator: GSXRspartan
publicationBasis: Repository creation date reported by GitHub; not a verified first release or forum announcement date.
